thread:
maria: Hey team — PR 40021 (https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/40021) is blocked on a flaky e2e smoke failure in CI. I need 1x LGTM to merge; I can open a follow-up ticket to investigate. Can someone rerun shard-3 or give a quick approval if they don't think this is a regression?

sam: @maria can you paste the failing test name and the last error log?

maria: Sure — failing test is `ui/smoke/login_flow.test.js` on shard-3. Error seen in CI: `TimeoutError: expected element to be visible within 5000ms`. It passes locally for me most times. CI build: https://ci.redwood/builds/12345

ci-bot: Build #12345 — status: failed (1 flaky failure). Rerun command: `kite rerun --shard=3 --target=tests/ui/smoke/login_flow.test.js`

lee: @maria I can kick a rerun in ~10m and eyeball the change. If rerun passes and there's no suspicious code, I'm fine giving LGTM but please open a follow-up issue for the flake.

maria: Thanks @lee — short log snippet here:
```
TimeoutError: element not visible
  at waitFor (src/e2e/helpers.js:42:12)
  at loginFlow (tests/ui/smoke/login_flow.test.js:27:5)
```

aj: If it's timing-sensitive it could be CI load/noise. Maybe try rerunning on pool-2 (less loaded) if the first rerun flakes again.

sam: @lee when you rerun, can you please target the same commit hash so we don't conflate results with a rebase?

lee: Will rerun same commit. Starting targeted rerun now. :rocket:

ci-bot: Rerun #12346 started (shard-3) — targeting commit 9f3a2c1

lee: Rerun finished — shard-3 passed (all green). Looks like a transient timing issue.

lee: @maria happy to LGTM after you open a follow-up ticket to track investigation and add a flakiness tag.

maria: I opened issue #4023 and added details + steps-to-reproduce notes in the PR description. Also added label `flaky-e2e`. Requesting LGTM from @aj and @sam if you're ok with the follow-up.

aj: Quick glance at the UI change — looks small and safe, nothing obvious causing hangs. LGTM. Please link the issue.

sam: LGTM from me as well. Merge when ready.

maria: Thanks all — merging now. I'll keep an eye on CI and follow up on #4023 if the flake recurs. :tada:
